marines.moreauContact: Contact. One hostile. It's... knee-high. Nobody run. It can smell it.
marines.rookThat: That's it? THAT ate Second Squad?
marines.diazFace: Sarge, it has a face. A little face.
marines.haleLittleFace: Look at its little face. I'm going to pet it.
marines.diazBones: That's no ordinary Wooka. Look at the nail in the club, man. LOOK AT THE BONES.
marines.moreauHale: Hale. Hale was a good Marine. Hale was also a very small bite.
marines.moreauSmell: I love the smell of Wooka in the morning. It smells like... we're done.
marines.titleEndSub: Hold the line. Surely you can't be serious. We are. Don't call us Shirley.

wooka.kin3: Is it bonk? Is it bonk now?
wooka.narrator: Nobody asked the Chub to do that. Nobody ever does. It is, to be fair, a very good throw.
wooka.titleKin: The armoured ones have come into {into}
wooka.chiefCaption: The shiny ones came to hunt us. Let's show them whose {ours} it is.
wooka.titleHuntSub: Show them the {ours}. Do not feed the Chub.

mossback.marinesSub: Rifles barely mark it. Rockets. Strikes. Anything heavy.
